_comment: Return-to-Control tool for the custom Pre-visit Intake Agent. Deliberately carries NO urgency or severity field: the agent records what the patient said and a clinician decides. Adding an agent-assigned urgency level would turn this into a clinical assessment.
description: Hand the patient to a clinician with the verified patient id, the stated reason for the visit, and a short factual summary of what the patient said. Never include an assessment, a severity or urgency level, or a diagnosis.

patientId.description: The verified patient id returned by the verifyPatient tool

reason.description: Short reason for the visit, in the patient's own terms

visitSummary.description: Two to three sentence factual restatement of what the patient said they want their clinician to know. No interpretation, no assessment, no diagnosis.
